arms.S0: 32-cell state-aware flat sequential routing, four hard visits
arms.R0: 32-cell fixed random graph, out-degree 8, four hard visits
arms.G0: 32-cell learned sparse graph, out-degree 8, four hard visits
arms.G0-no-edge: post-hoc graph perturbation of the same G0 checkpoint; no retraining

decision_boundaries.b1: S0 versus P0 under matched cell capacity, visits, data and training-token budget
decision_boundaries.b2_primary: G0 versus R0, then separately versus the strong S0 baseline
decision_boundaries.system: G0 versus M0 on held-out PPL, unique touched weights, whole-model observed GEMM FLOPs and actual batch-1 KV-cache decode latency
decision_boundaries.no_edge_claim: G0-no-edge is a post-hoc mechanism diagnostic, not an independent trained arm

not_registered_because: no collision-free development/confirmation seed matrix has been registered
the independent held-out data slice and its content hash are not yet frozen
edge-refresh candidate sampling and matched-compute controls remain unspecified
the bootstrap and decode measurement procedures remain proposals

measurement_proposal.quality_sampling: non-overlapping windows contained in stories; paired story-cluster bootstrap
measurement_proposal.decode_sampling: 30 independent prefill/cache-reset runs, 33 decode tokens each; first token separate, 960 warm samples; bootstrap whole runs
measurement_proposal.initialization: per-parameter-name SHA256-derived RNG streams; identical shared tensor initialization across all arms
measurement_proposal.auxiliary_loss: N * sum(mean(probability)^2), averaged over sequential hops and blocks; coefficient 0.01 for all arms
measurement_proposal.graph_sources: 4 consecutive cyclic source rows per refresh; START plus all 32 Cells covered in <=9 events; force predecessors for counterfactual probes and record natural support separately
measurement_proposal.graph_benefit: signed PPL degradation under important-edge perturbation; improvement cannot support B2
